blake3.why: This repository is a fork of it: src/, c/, b3sum/, reference_impl/, test_vectors/ are upstream's, merged by scripts/sync-upstream.sh. Its pin is the merge base.

watch.c/blake3.c: bend/lib/patch.py hooks compress_subtree_to_parent_node here (libturboblake, every binding)
watch.c/blake3.h: the C API every binding exposes (bend/lib, python, node, go)
watch.c/*: bend/lib/gen.sh copies the official C into bend/lib/csrc; bend/go/gen.sh into bend/go/csrc
watch.src/lib.rs: bend/rust/patch_crate.py anchors (the subtree hook) in the turboblake crate
watch.Cargo.toml: the crate's version, features and dependencies; patch_crate.py rewrites it
watch.b3sum/src/*: bend/rust/patch_b3sum.py anchors (the fast path, the pool); the turboblake CLI
watch.b3sum/tests/*: the CLI tests, copied into bend/crate/tests
watch.b3sum/Cargo.toml: the CLI's dependencies, merged into bend/crate/Cargo.toml
watch.test_vectors/*: the official vectors; copied to bend/python/tests and bend/go/testdata

blake3-py.why: bend/python is blake3-py's C implementation and tests on libturboblake: `import blake3` must keep its API (PyPI blake3).

watch.src/lib.rs: the Rust module PyPI ships: its API and behavior are what blake3module.c must match
watch.pyproject.toml: supported Pythons and build settings (compare bend/python/pyproject.toml, setup.py)

go-lukechampine.why: bend/go (github.com/gunta/turboblake/bend/go) has lukechampine.com/blake3's API; the bench races it.

watch.*.go: exported API and behavior bend/go/blake3.go mirrors

go-zeebo.why: bend/go/zeebo has github.com/zeebo/blake3's API; the bench races it.

watch.*.go: exported API and behavior bend/go/zeebo/blake3.go mirrors

noble-hashes.why: The npm package turboblake is a drop-in for @noble/hashes/blake3: blake3(data, {dkLen, key, context}), blake3.create().

watch.src/blake3.ts: the blake3 API bend/node mirrors (api.js, index.js, index.d.ts, js/index.js)
watch.src/utils.ts: the hash interface (create, update, digest, clone, destroy)

bend2.why: Bend2 compiles blake3.bend, engine.bend and the proofs; a new compiler changes the emitted C (bend/lib/csrc/engine.c, every binding) and may change speed or what checks.
